description: AMF-regulated asset-management arm of Turgot Capital, an independent French financial group founded in 2003 that vertically integrates three businesses: financial and real-estate asset management (Turgot Asset Management), life-insurance solution design/brokerage (Turgot Life), and investment/asset-allocation advisory (Turgot Wealth). Turgot Capital joined Groupe Magellim in February 2022. Recent leadership change: Guillaume Hilaire became President on 2025-02-24, succeeding Francois Grandvoinnet; Sonia Raimbault is Directeur General.
